original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹坦布拉县SPLM初选投票遭枪击干扰
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州坦布拉县执政党SPLM初选投票期间发生枪击，约71名代表逃离投票现场未能投票。当地官员称枪击似意在恐吓选民、扰乱投票，而非直接袭击投票站。西赤道州信息部长指认疑似苏丹人民解放军反对派（SPLA-IO）武装发动射击，但SPLA-IO方面未予回应。官方称无人员受伤，局势已于当日下午恢复正常。

key_facts.fact: 坦布拉县SPLM初选投票期间发生枪击，71名代表逃离未能投票
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Gunfire disrupted voting in the ruling SPLM primaries in Tambura County, Western Equatoria State, on Wednesday, forcing 71 delegates to flee without voting

key_facts.fact: 枪击发生在投票点约一英里外，时间约为上午11时30分
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the shooting occurred at around 11:30 a.m., about one mile from Freedom Square, where the voting was taking place

key_facts.fact: 西赤道州信息部长指认疑似SPLA-IO武装发动射击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Western Equatoria State Information Minister Noah Issah Philip blamed suspected Sudan People’s Liberation Army in Opposition (SPLA-IO) forces for the shooting

key_facts.fact: 官方称无人员受伤，局势于当日下午恢复正常
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: No injuries were reported, and the situation returned to normal by the afternoon

key_facts.fact: 枪击前一日社交媒体出现自称SPLA-IO成员的袭击警告
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The shooting followed warnings circulated on social media on Tuesday by individuals identifying themselves as members of the SPLA-IO

uncertainties: 枪击发动方身份尚未证实，SPLA-IO方面未予回应
枪击具体时间说法不一：县长称约11时30分，州信息部长称约11时
枪击动机为恐吓选民属官员判断，尚未获独立证实
目前仅单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，缺乏交叉验证
